test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Identify the wrong statement. In a family of six members, A, B, C, D, E, and F:

• A and B are a married couple.

• C is the son of A.

• E is the brother of D.

• D is the daughter of B.

F is the mother of B.

options.text: C is the only son of A
E is the brother of D
F is the mother of B
D is the daughter of B

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd7f045f5d1e046a1593211d33470dd7222228da44053b077ae0ffa769768dc2.png] 

Family tree,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e09ffe7f3dd955895c7a4abbec67d26e5b67feb130a8004f4df3f5e44a4cf174.png] 

(1) C is the only son of A→ **Wrong (Because E is also son of A)**

(2) E is the brother of D → Correct

(3) F is the mother of B → Correct

(4) D is the daughter of B → Correct.

Hence, the correct answer is “**Option 1**”.
